                id: p.id
            })));
            
            // Try to match based on ar_marker field
            let matchedPoster = null;
            
            if (sceneMarker) {
                // Match by comparing ar_marker paths
                matchedPoster = window.allPosters.find(p => {
                    const posterMarker = p.ar_marker;
                    console.log(`🔎 Comparing: scene="${sceneMarker}" vs poster="${posterMarker}" (${p.title})`);
                    return posterMarker && sceneMarker.includes(posterMarker);
                });
            }
            
            // Fallback to first poster if no match found
            if (!matchedPoster) {
                console.warn('⚠️ No marker match found, using first poster as fallback');
                matchedPoster = window.allPosters[0];
            } else {
                console.log('✅ Matched poster:', matchedPoster.title, 'via ar_marker:', matchedPoster.ar_marker);
            }
            
            currentTrackedPoster = matchedPoster;
            document.getElementById('detected-poster-title').textContent = matchedPoster.title;
            console.log('📝 Updated footer title to:', matchedPoster.title);
            
            // Update AR layers with poster-specific data
            if (matchedPoster.layers) {
                console.log('🎨 Updating AR layers with poster-specific configuration...');
                for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
                    const layerData = matchedPoster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
                    const layerElement = document.getElementById(`ar-layer-${i}`);
                    
                    if (layerElement) {
                        if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                            // Update layer with poster data
                            const layerSrc = `/uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                            const materialAttr = `src: ${layerSrc}; shader: flat; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double`;
                            
                            layerElement.setAttribute('material', materialAttr);
                            layerElement.setAttribute('position', `0 0 ${layerData.z}`);
                            
                            // Apply blend mode if exclusion filter
                            if (layerData.exclusion_filter) {
                                setTimeout(() => {
                                    try {
                                        const mesh = layerElement.getObject3D('mesh');
                                        if (mesh && mesh.material) {
                                            mesh.material.transparent = true;
                                            mesh.material.opacity = 1.0;
                                            mesh.material.blending = THREE.CustomBlending;
                                            mesh.material.blendSrc = THREE.SrcColorFactor;
                                            mesh.material.blendDst = THREE.DstColorFactor;
                                            mesh.material.blendEquation = THREE.SubtractEquation;
                                            mesh.material.needsUpdate = true;
                                            console.log(`🎭 Difference blend mode applied to layer ${i}`);
                                        }
                                    } catch (e) {
                                        console.error(`Failed to apply blend to layer ${i}:`, e);
                                    }
                                }, 50);
                            }
                            
                            // Remove old animations
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__x');
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__y');
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__z');
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__scale');
                            
                            // Add animation if configured
                            if (layerData.anim_duration > 0) {
                                const animX = layerData.anim_x || 0;
                                const animY = layerData.anim_y || 0;
                                const animZ = layerData.anim_z || 0;
                                
                                if (animX !== 0) layerElement.setAttribute('animation__x', `property: position.x; from: ${-animX}; to: ${animX}; dur: ${layerData.anim_duration}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);

                                if (animZ !== 0) layerElement.setAttribute('animation__z', `property: position.z; from: ${layerData.z - animZ}; to: ${layerData.z + animZ}; dur: ${layerData.anim_duration + 2000}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);

                            layerElement.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
                            console.log(`✅ Layer ${i} updated: ${layerData.filename} at z=${layerData.z}${layerData.exclusion_filter ? ' (exclusion)' : ''}`);
                        } else {
                            // No data for this layer - hide it
                            layerElement.setAttribute('visible', 'false');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Make ALL layers visible

        const layer2 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-2');
        const layer3 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-3');
        const layer4 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-4');
        
        target.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer1) layer1.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer2) layer2.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer3) layer3.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer4) layer4.object3D.visible = true;
        
        targetFoundTimestamp = Date.now();
        
        // Hide background video immediately on target found
        // Video hiding is INDEPENDENT of blend modes being ready
        // Blend modes are purely for visual effect, not for hiding/showing
        if (!videoHiddenForTarget) {
            console.log('✅ Target found - immediately hiding video');

                canvas.style.visibility = 'visible';

            // Also hide any background overlays
            const bgElements = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="background"], [id*="background"]');
            bgElements.forEach(el => {
                if (el !== canvas) {

                }
            });
            
            hideARLoader(); // Hide the loading spinner
            console.log('📹 Background video hidden');
            videoHiddenForTarget = true;
        }
        
        // DO NOT apply offset here - will be handled by continuous adjustment
        console.log('🎯 Target position (MindAR native):', {
            x: target.object3D.position.x,
            y: target.object3D.position.y,
            z: target.object3D.position.z
        });
    });
    
    target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
        console.log('❌ Image target lost');
        
        // Switch back to state 1 (gallery button)
        showSwipeState(1);
        currentTrackedPoster = null;
        
        // If video was hidden, restore it after a delay
        // But ONLY if targetFound hasn't fired in the meantime
        if (videoHiddenForTarget) {
            if (targetLostResetTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostResetTimeout);
            }
            
            targetLostResetTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                // Double-check that video is still supposed to be hidden
                // (in case targetFound was triggered while we were waiting)
                if (videoHiddenForTarget) {
                    console.log('⏳ Restoring after 1000ms delay...');
                    
                    // Restore background video and canvas positioning
                    const backgroundVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
                    backgroundVideos.forEach(video => {
                        video.style.visibility = 'visible';
                        video.style.opacity = '1';
                        video.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                    });
                    
                    // Restore A4 frame guide
                    const a4Frame = document.getElementById('a4-frame');
                    if (a4Frame) {
                        a4Frame.classList.remove('hidden');
                        console.log('📦 A4 frame restored');
                    }
                    
                    // Reset canvas z-index to allow video underneath
                    const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
                    if (canvas) {
                        canvas.style.zIndex = '10'; // Back to default
                        console.log('🎨 Canvas z-index reset to default (10)');
                    }
                    
                    console.log('📹 Background video restored');
                    videoHiddenForTarget = false; // Reset flag for next detection
                    console.log('✅ Flag reset - ready for next detection');
                } else {
                    console.log('⏭️ Skipping restore - targetFound already triggered');
                }
                targetLostResetTimeout = null;
            }, 1000); // Increased to 1000ms to give MindAR time to re-stabilize
        }
    });
    
    scene.appendChild(target);
    
    console.log('✅ MindAR target with 4 image layers added');
    
    // LISTEN FOR targetFound EVENT on SCENE level (MindAR broadcasts to scene, not target)
    scene.addEventListener('targetFound', (event) => {
        // Re-dispatch to target element if needed, or handle directly
        if (event.detail?.targetIndex === 0) {
            const targetEl = scene.querySelector('[mindar-image-target]');
            if (targetEl) {
                const customEvent = new CustomEvent('targetFound', { detail: event.detail });
                targetEl.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Fix camera and renderer after scene is ready
    setTimeout(() => {
        const camera = scene.camera;
        const renderer = scene.renderer;
        
        if (camera) {
            // Fix camera near clipping (was 10, now 0.01)
            camera.near = 0.01;
            camera.far = 10000;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            console.log('✅ Camera near/far fixed:', camera.near, camera.far);
            
            // Safari-specific: Force aspect ratio recalculation
            const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
            if (isSafari) {
                console.log('🔧 Safari detected - applying browser-specific fixes');
                
                // Safari handles aspect ratio differently
                const width = window.innerWidth;
                const height = window.innerHeight;
                const aspectRatio = width / height;
                
                camera.aspect = aspectRatio;
                camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
                console.log('📐 Safari aspect ratio adjusted to:', aspectRatio);
                
                // Force pixel ratio consistency in Safari
                const pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                console.log('📱 Device pixel ratio:', pixelRatio);
            }
        }
        
        if (renderer) {
            const size = renderer.getSize(new THREE.Vector2());
            if (size.x === 0 || size.y === 0) {

                renderer.setSize(canvas.width || 393, canvas.height || 556, false);
                console.log('✅ Renderer size fixed');
            }
        }
        
        // Force target and layers visibility
        const layer1 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-1');
        const layer2 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-2');

            if (layer1) layer1.object3D.visible = true;
            if (layer2) layer2.object3D.visible = true;

        }
    }, 500);
    
    // Continuous monitoring - track MindAR status
    let fixedMindARVideoSize = false;
    let targetWasDetected = false; // Track if target was ever detected
    let targetLostResetTimeout = null;
    
    // Listen for targetFound event (redirected from scene by our listener above)
    target.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
        if (!targetWasDetected) {
            console.log('✨ Target detected and tracked (via targetFound event)');
            targetWasDetected = true;
            
            // Cancel any pending reset
            if (targetLostResetTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostResetTimeout);
                targetLostResetTimeout = null;
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Listen for targetLost event
    target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
        if (targetWasDetected) {
            console.log('❌ Target lost - showing video again');
            
            // Show background video again so user can scan
            const backgroundVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            backgroundVideos.forEach(video => {
                video.style.visibility = 'visible';
                video.style.opacity = '1';
                video.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; // Re-enable interaction
            });
            
            // Show A4 frame guide again
            const a4Frame = document.getElementById('a4-frame');
            if (a4Frame) {
                a4Frame.classList.remove('hidden');
                console.log('📦 A4 frame shown');
            }
            
            videoHiddenForTarget = false;
            
            // Don't reset immediately, wait for potential re-detection
            targetLostResetTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                console.log('✅ Target reset - ready for next detection');
                targetWasDetected = false;
            }, 1000);
        }
    });
    
    setInterval(() => {
        // CRITICAL FIX: Force MindAR's video element to correct size
        // This is the root cause of Safari's positioning issues
        if (!fixedMindARVideoSize && target.object3D.visible) {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            let mindARVideo = null;
            let backgroundVideo = null;
            
            // Identify which video is MindAR's and which is background
            allVideos.forEach(v => {
                if (v.id === 'camera-feed') {
                    backgroundVideo = v;
                } else if (v.videoWidth === 0 && v.videoHeight === 0) {
                    // This is MindAR's video (currently 0x0)
                    mindARVideo = v;
                }
            });
            
            // If we found MindAR's video and it's still 0x0, fix it
            if (mindARVideo && mindARVideo.videoWidth === 0) {
                // Get the camera's actual resolution
                if (backgroundVideo && backgroundVideo.videoWidth > 0) {
                    const correctWidth = backgroundVideo.videoWidth;
                    const correctHeight = backgroundVideo.videoHeight;
                    
                    console.log(`🔧 Fixing MindAR video size: 0x0 → ${correctWidth}x${correctHeight}`);
                    // Force the canvas size in the scene
                    const canvas = document.querySelector('a-scene canvas');
                    if (canvas) {
                        canvas.width = correctWidth;
                        canvas.height = correctHeight;
                    }
                    
                    // This helps MindAR recalculate its projection matrix
                    const renderer = scene.renderer;
                    if (renderer) {
                        const pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                        renderer.setSize(correctWidth, correctHeight, false);
                        console.log('✅ Renderer resized to', correctWidth, 'x', correctHeight);
                    }
                    
                    fixedMindARVideoSize = true;
                }
            }
        } else if (!target.object3D.visible) {
            // Target is NOT visible - reset the fix flag so we try again next detection
            fixedMindARVideoSize = false;
        }
    }, 2000);
    
    // CONTINUOUS LAYER OFFSET ADJUSTMENT FOR SAFARI
    // Safari's MindAR pose is different from Chrome
    // Instead of offsetting the target, we adjust individual layer Y positions
    const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    const SAFARI_LAYER_Y_OFFSET = -0.35; // Shift layers down in Safari
    
    if (isSafari) {
        console.log('🔧 Safari detected - applying layer-level positioning fixes');
    }
    
    // Adjust layers every frame to compensate for Safari's different pose
    let lastSafariOffset = null;
    let offsetAdjustmentCount = 0;
    
    // Read offset from URL parameter if available (for testing: ?safariOffsetY=-0.3)
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    let safariYOffset = parseFloat(urlParams.get('safariOffsetY')) || -0.30;
    
    console.log(`🔧 Safari Y offset configured: ${safariYOffset} (use ?safariOffsetY=VALUE to adjust)`);
    
    function applySafariLayerAdjustment() {
        const layer1 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-1');
        const layer2 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-2');
        const layer3 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-3');
        const layer4 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-4');
        
        if (target.object3D.visible && layer1 && layer2 && layer3 && layer4) {
            if (isSafari) {
                // Apply Safari offset to each layer's Y position
                // Value is fine-tuned and can be adjusted via URL parameter
                
                // Only set if not already set (avoid redundant updates)
                if (lastSafariOffset !== safariYOffset) {
                    layer1.object3D.position.y = safariYOffset;
                    layer2.object3D.position.y = 0.02 + safariYOffset;
                    layer3.object3D.position.y = 0.20 + safariYOffset;
                    layer4.object3D.position.y = 0.30 + safariYOffset;
                    
                    // Update matrices for Three.js
                    layer1.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    layer2.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    layer3.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    layer4.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    
                    lastSafariOffset = safariYOffset;
                    offsetAdjustmentCount++;
                    
                    // Log first adjustment and every 60 frames
                    if (offsetAdjustmentCount === 1 || offsetAdjustmentCount % 60 === 0) {
                        console.log(`📍 Safari layer offset: y=${safariYOffset}`);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(applySafariLayerAdjustment);
    }
    applySafariLayerAdjustment();
    
    console.log('✅ MindAR target added');
    
    // NOW that targets are loaded, MindAR should auto-start (autoStart: true in HTML)
    console.log('🚀 MindAR configured to auto-start...');

// Setup Swipe Bar Controls
function setupSwipeBarControls() {
    const closeDetectionBtn = document.getElementById('close-detection-btn');
    const swipeBar = document.getElementById('ar-footer-swipe-bar');
    const footerHeader = document.querySelector('.footer-header');
    
    // Close detection button (state 2) - returns to state 1 and gallery
    if (closeDetectionBtn) {
        closeDetectionBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            console.log('❌ Closing detected poster, showing gallery...');
            
            // Switch back to state 1 (gallery)
            showSwipeState(1);
            currentTrackedPoster = null;
            
            // Collapse footer first
            swipeBar.classList.remove('detected-mode');
            swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
            
            // Clean up
            setTimeout(() => {
                const galleryContent = document.getElementById('gallery-content');
                delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
            }, 400);
        });
    }
    
    // Drag up to expand footer/gallery (single unified element)
    let touchStartY = 0;
    let touchCurrentY = 0;
    let touchStartTime = 0;
    let isDragging = false;
    let startHeight = 0;
    
    footerHeader.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
        // Ignore if touching the close button
        if (e.target.closest('.close-btn')) return;
        
        touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        touchCurrentY = touchStartY;
        touchStartTime = Date.now();
        isDragging = true;
        
        // Get current height
        const currentHeightVh = swipeBar.classList.contains('expanded') ? 94 : 6;
        startHeight = (currentHeightVh / 100) * window.innerHeight;
        
        // Remove transition for smooth dragging
        swipeBar.style.transition = 'none';
    });
    
    footerHeader.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        
        // Prevent page scroll/refresh when dragging footer
        e.preventDefault();
        
        touchCurrentY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        const deltaY = touchStartY - touchCurrentY; // Positive = drag up
        
        // Calculate new height (footer expands upward)
        const newHeight = Math.min(Math.max(startHeight + deltaY, window.innerHeight * 0.06), window.innerHeight * 0.94);
        swipeBar.style.height = `${newHeight}px`;
        
        // Show gallery content when dragging up
        const galleryContent = document.getElementById('gallery-content');
        if (deltaY > 20 && !galleryContent.dataset.loaded) {
            loadGalleryOverlay();
            galleryContent.dataset.loaded = 'true';
            galleryContent.style.opacity = '1'; // Direct visible, geen fade
        }
        
    }, { passive: false });
    
    footerHeader.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        isDragging = false;
        
        const touchDuration = Date.now() - touchStartTime;
        const dragDistance = touchStartY - touchCurrentY;
        const dragPercent = (dragDistance / window.innerHeight) * 100;
        
        // Restore transition
        swipeBar.style.transition = 'height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1)';
        swipeBar.style.height = ''; // Let CSS class handle it
        
        const galleryContent = document.getElementById('gallery-content');
        galleryContent.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
        
        const state1Active = document.getElementById('swipe-state-1').classList.contains('active');
        const state2Active = document.getElementById('swipe-state-2').classList.contains('active');
        
        const isExpanded = swipeBar.classList.contains('expanded');
        
        // If dragged more than 20% OR quick tap, toggle
        if (dragPercent > 20 || (touchDuration < 200 && Math.abs(dragDistance) < 10)) {
            if (!isExpanded && state1Active) {
                // Expand footer to show gallery
                swipeBar.classList.add('expanded');
                swipeBar.classList.remove('detected-mode');
                loadGalleryOverlay();
                galleryContent.dataset.loaded = 'true';
            } else if (!isExpanded && state2Active && currentTrackedPoster) {
                // Expand footer to show detected poster details
                swipeBar.classList.add('expanded');
                swipeBar.classList.add('detected-mode');
                showDetectedPosterDetails(currentTrackedPoster);
            } else if (isExpanded) {
                // Collapse footer
                swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
                swipeBar.classList.remove('detected-mode');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
                }, 400);
            }
        }
        // Dragged down while expanded - collapse
        else if (dragPercent < -10 && isExpanded) {
            swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
            setTimeout(() => {
                delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
            }, 400);
        }
        // Didn't drag far enough - snap to current state
        else if (isExpanded) {
            swipeBar.classList.add('expanded');
        } else {
            swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
            delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
        }
    }, { passive: true });
}

    console.log('✅ Gallery ready');
}
// Load Gallery Overlay with all posters
function loadGalleryOverlay() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('gallery-overlay-grid');

    // Force CSS injection when gallery opens

        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'gallery-override-styles';
        style.textContent = `
            #gallery-overlay { background: #af1d1f !important; }
            .overlay-header { background: #af1d1f !important; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important; }
            .overlay-title { color: #000 !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; font-weight: 700 !important; letter-spacing: 0.15em !important; font-size: 0.85rem !important; }
            .close-overlay-btn { color: #000 !important; font-size: 2.5rem !important; }
            #gallery-overlay-grid { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 2rem !important; padding: 2rem 1.5rem !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card { display: block !important; background: #fff !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.25s ease !important; border-radius: 8px !important; overflow: hidden !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card:active { opacity: 0.85 !important; transform: scale(0.98) !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card img { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block !important; border: none !important; background: #000 !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card h3 { padding: 14px 12px !important; font-size: 0.85rem !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #000 !important; margin: 0 !important; letter-spacing: 0.05em !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; background: #fff !important; }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
        console.log('✅ Gallery CSS injected');
    }
    
    grid.innerHTML = window.allPosters.map(poster => {
        const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png';
        return `
        <div class="overlay-poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <h3>${poster.title}</h3>
        </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
    
    // Add click handlers
    grid.querySelectorAll('.overlay-poster-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const posterId = card.dataset.posterId;
            showPosterModal(posterId);
        });
    });
}

        return `

        });

// Show poster modal
async function showPosterModal(posterId) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters/${posterId}`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Kan poster niet laden');
        
        const poster = await response.json();
        currentPoster = poster;
        
        // Update modal content
        const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : (poster.jpeg_url ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.jpeg_url}` : 'img/placeholder.png');
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-img').src = imageUrl;
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-img').onerror = function() { this.src = 'img/placeholder.png'; };
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-title').textContent = poster.title;
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-description').textContent = poster.description || '';
        
        // Location info
        let locationText = '';
        if (poster.location_description) {
            locationText = poster.location_description;
        }
        if (poster.latitude && poster.longitude) {
            locationText += locationText ? ` (${poster.latitude}, ${poster.longitude})` : `${poster.latitude}, ${poster.longitude}`;
        }
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-location').textContent = locationText ? `Locatie: ${locationText}` : '';
        
        // Article link
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-article').innerHTML = poster.artikel_link ? `<a href="${poster.artikel_link}" target="_blank">Lees het originele artikel</a>` : '';
        
        // Photographer credit
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-photographer').textContent = poster.photographer_credit ? `Foto: ${poster.photographer_credit}` : '';
        
        // Download count
        document.getElementById('modal-download-count').textContent = poster.downloads || 0;
        
        // Show modal
        document.getElementById('download-modal').style.display = 'block';
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading poster:', error);
    }
}
// Setup modal
function setupModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('download-modal');
    const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.close');
    
    closeBtn.onclick = () => {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
    };
    
    window.onclick = (event) => {
        if (event.target === modal) {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    };
    
    // Download buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('.download-btn').forEach(btn => {

        btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {

            const format = e.target.dataset.format;

            const size = e.target.dataset.size;

            

            if (!currentPoster) return;

            

            const url = `${API_URL}/download/${currentPoster.id}?format=${format}&size=${size}`;

            window.location.href = url;

        });

    });

}

De oorzaak is nu duidelijk: de AR-engine werkt, de camera werkt, de marker wordt geladen, maar **de poster wordt niet herkend** (geen targetFound logs, geen AR-laag zichtbaar).

**Oorzaak:**  
De event listeners en AR-logica zijn nu volledig afhankelijk van de "stable" events (`stableTargetFound`), maar de filters worden alleen getriggerd als MindAR daadwerkelijk een target detecteert. Als de marker niet wordt herkend, gebeurt er niets.

**Mogelijke oorzaken:**
1. **De .mind file of marker klopt niet** (fout pad, corrupt, niet gegenereerd voor deze poster).
2. **De AR-laag wordt niet zichtbaar gemaakt** omdat de filters nooit een "pass" krijgen.
3. **De camera ziet de marker niet goed** (belichting, printkwaliteit, afstand).

**Wat werkt wél volgens de logs:**
- De .mind file wordt geladen (`✅ .mind file loaded successfully`).
- De target entity wordt aangemaakt (`✅ MindAR target with 4 image layers added`).
- De camera werkt (`✅ Camera permission granted`, `✅ Background camera feed now playing`).

**Wat ontbreekt:**
- Geen enkele `targetFound` of `trackingFiltersPassed` log.
- Geen enkele melding dat de marker is herkend.

---

**Actieplan:**
1. **Controleer of de juiste .mind file wordt gebruikt** (pad klopt, file bestaat, is niet leeg).
2. **Controleer of de marker daadwerkelijk zichtbaar is voor de camera** (probeer met een testmarker die eerder werkte).
3. **Log direct na het laden van de .mind file of MindAR targets daadwerkelijk geladen zijn.**
4. **Zet een extra debug-log in de MindAR targetFound event** om te zien of deze überhaupt ooit wordt getriggerd.

Wil je dat ik een extra debug-log toevoeg direct na het laden van de .mind file en in de MindAR targetFound event, zodat we zeker weten of MindAR de marker überhaupt ziet?

// Main.js - AR.js Version (iOS Compatible)

// API Configuration
const API_URL = window.location.origin + '/api';
const BASE_URL = window.location.origin; // Voor statische bestanden

// ==================== DEVICE DETECTION & AR INITIALIZATION ====================
let isMobileDevice = false;
let isARSupported = false;
window.allPosters = []; // Global array for AR tracking
let videoHiddenForTarget = false; // Global flag for video visibility toggle
let blendModesReady = false; // Track if blend modes are applied
let targetFoundTimestamp = 0; // Track when target was found

// Initialize detection filters
window.detectionFilters = {
    minConfidenceThreshold: 0.6, // Lower threshold for easier detection
    warmupFrames: 5,             // Frames to wait before showing content
    frameCount: 0,               // Current warmup frame count
    missTolerance: 5,            // Frames to wait before declaring lost
    missCount: 0,                // Current miss count
    missFrames: 10,              // Frames to wait before declaring lost (synonym for missTolerance logic)
    positionHistory: [],         // History for smoothing
    maxHistorySize: 5            // Size of smoothing buffer
};

// Hide loader when everything is ready
function hideARLoader() {
    const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
    if (loader) {
        loader.style.opacity = '0';
        loader.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
        setTimeout(() => {
            loader.style.display = 'none';
        }, 300);
    }
}

// Show A4 frame guide (called on init and when target is lost)
function showA4Frame() {
    const a4Frame = document.getElementById('a4-frame');
    if (a4Frame) {
        a4Frame.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
}

// Timeout for resetting flags after target is lost
let targetLostResetTimeout = null;

let currentTrackedPoster = null;

// Detect mobile device
function detectMobileDevice() {
    const userAgent = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    const isMobile = /android|webos|iphone|ipad|ipod|blackberry|iemobile|opera mini/i.test(userAgent);
    const isTablet = /(ipad|tablet|(android(?!.*mobile))|(windows(?!.*phone)(.*touch))|kindle|playbook|silk|(puffin(?!.*(IP|AP|WP))))/.test(userAgent);
    
    console.log('🔍 Device Detection:', {
        userAgent,
        isMobile,
        isTablet,
        result: isMobile || isTablet
    });
    
    return isMobile || isTablet;
}

// Check if browser supports WebGL for AR
function checkARSupport() {
    // Check for WebGL support
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
    
    if (!gl) {
        console.log('❌ WebGL not supported');
        return false;
    }
    
    // AR.js works on HTTP for development, but camera requires HTTPS in production
    const isHTTPS = window.location.protocol === 'https:';
    const isLocalhost = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1';
    
    if (!isHTTPS && !isLocalhost) {
        console.log('⚠️ Camera requires HTTPS (or localhost) - current:', window.location.protocol);
        console.log('💡 Upload to HTTPS website for camera access');
    }
    
    console.log('✅ AR Support: WebGL available');
    return true;
}

// Initialize AR mode with AR.js
async function initializeARMode() {
    console.log('🚀 Starting AR.js initialization...');
    
    try {
        // Fetch all posters from API
        console.log('� Fetching posters from API...');
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Cannot fetch posters');
        
        window.allPosters = await response.json();
        console.log('✅ Fetched', window.allPosters.length, 'posters');
        console.log('📋 Poster AR markers:', window.allPosters.map(p => ({
            title: p.title,
            ar_marker: p.ar_marker || 'NO MARKER SET',
            id: p.id
        })));
        
        // PRELOAD all textures from all posters so they're cached before AR target detection
        // This ensures first scan shows textures immediately without white flash
        console.log('🖼️ Preloading all poster layer textures...');
        const texturePreloadPromises = [];
        for (const poster of window.allPosters) {
            if (poster.layers) {
                for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
                    const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
                    if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                        const imgUrl = `/uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                        // Create promise that resolves when image loads
                        const loadPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                            const img = new Image();
                            img.onload = () => resolve(imgUrl);
                            img.onerror = () => {
                                console.warn(`⚠️ Failed to preload: ${imgUrl}`);
                                resolve(imgUrl); // Resolve even on error
                            };
                            img.src = imgUrl;
                        });
                        texturePreloadPromises.push(loadPromise);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Wait for all textures to preload (with timeout)
        Promise.race([
            Promise.all(texturePreloadPromises),
            new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 5000)) // 5 second timeout
        ]).then(() => {
            console.log('✅ Textures preloaded (or timeout reached)');
        });

        // Determine marker path dynamically
        let markerPath = 'assets/nft/AR_test_01/AR_test_01.mind'; // Default fallback
        const posterWithMarker = window.allPosters.find(p => p.ar_marker);
        
        if (posterWithMarker) {
            markerPath = posterWithMarker.ar_marker.endsWith('.mind') 
                ? posterWithMarker.ar_marker 
                : posterWithMarker.ar_marker + '.mind';
            console.log('🎯 Found poster with marker:', posterWithMarker.title);
        } else {
            console.warn('⚠️ No poster with marker found, using default test marker');
        }
        
        window.currentMarkerPath = markerPath;
        console.log('🎯 Using marker path:', markerPath);
        
        // Switch to AR view
        console.log('� Switching to AR view...');
        document.getElementById('desktop-view').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('mobile-ar-view').style.display = 'flex';
        console.log('✅ AR view displayed');
        
        // Show A4 frame guide
        showA4Frame();
        console.log('📦 A4 frame initialized and visible');
        
        // INJECT SCENE DYNAMICALLY
        console.log('💉 Injecting AR scene with marker:', markerPath);
        const sceneContainer = document.getElementById('ar-scene-container');
        if (sceneContainer) {
            sceneContainer.innerHTML = `
            <a-scene
                id="ar-scene"
                mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${markerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no;"
                embedded
                vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                renderer="colorManagement: true; antialias: false; alpha: true; logarithmicDepthBuffer: true; precision: mediump; powerPreference: high-performance;"
                device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false"
                loading-screen="enabled: false">
                
                <!-- Camera with optimized FOV for 1x standard lens -->
                <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false" wasd-controls="enabled: false" camera="near: 0.01; far: 10000; fov: 70;"></a-camera>
                
                <!-- Image target will be added dynamically by JavaScript -->
            </a-scene>`;
        } else {
            console.error('❌ #ar-scene-container not found in DOM');
            // Fallback to camera container if scene container missing
            const camContainer = document.getElementById('ar-camera-container');
            if (camContainer) {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.id = 'ar-scene-container';
                div.innerHTML = `
                <a-scene
                    id="ar-scene"
                    mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${markerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no;"
                    embedded
                    vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                    renderer="colorManagement: true; antialias: false; alpha: true; logarithmicDepthBuffer: true; precision: mediump; powerPreference: high-performance;"
                    device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false"
                    loading-screen="enabled: false">
                    
                    <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false" wasd-controls="enabled: false" camera="near: 0.01; far: 10000; fov: 70;"></a-camera>
                </a-scene>`;
                camContainer.appendChild(div);
            }
        }
        
        // Wait for AR.js scene to be ready
        // Give a small delay for DOM update
        setTimeout(() => {
            const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
            
            if (!scene) {
                console.error('❌ Scene element not found after injection');
                return;
            }
            
            // Add a timeout check for scene loading
            const loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                console.warn('⚠️ Scene taking too long to load, checking status...');
                if (!scene.hasLoaded) {
                    console.error('❌ Scene failed to load within timeout');
                    alert('AR initialization timeout. Please check camera permissions and try again.');
                }
            }, 10000);
            
            if (scene.hasLoaded) {
                clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
                initializeARScene();
            } else {
                scene.addEventListener('loaded', () => {
                    clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
                    console.log('✅ A-Frame scene loaded');
                    initializeARScene();
                });
            }
        }, 100);
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ AR initialization failed:', error);
        showDesktopView();
        loadPosters();
        setupModal();
    }
}

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');

    // Check camera permissions first
    requestCameraPermission().then(() => {
        // CRITICAL: Wait for scene to be loaded before adding targets
        if (scene.hasLoaded) {
            console.log('✅ Scene already loaded, proceeding...');
            addMindARTargets(scene);
        } else {
            console.log('⏳ Waiting for scene to load before adding targets...');
            scene.addEventListener('loaded', () => {
                console.log('✅ Scene loaded event fired, adding targets...');
                addMindARTargets(scene);
            }, { once: true });
        }
        
        // FALLBACK TIMER: If arReady event doesn't fire, hide loader after 5 seconds
        // This ensures users don't get stuck on "AR LADEN..." forever
        setTimeout(() => {
            const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
            if (loader && loader.style.display !== 'none') {
                console.warn('⚠️ arReady timeout - forcefully hiding loader');
                hideARLoader();
            }
        }, 5000); // 5 second fallback timeout
        
    }).catch(err => {
        console.error('❌ Camera permission denied:', err);
    });
    
    // Listen for MindAR ready event
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // IMPORTANT: Hide the loader immediately when AR is ready
        // This ensures users see the camera feed even if no target is detected yet
        hideARLoader();
        console.log('👁️ AR READY - hiding loader and showing camera feed');
        
        // GET CAMERA STREAM FROM MINDAR AND DISPLAY IT
        // MindAR creates a video element internally, we need to copy it to our background video
        setTimeout(() => {
            // FIRST: Make canvas transparent so video shows through
            const canvas = scene.querySelector('canvas');
            if (canvas) {
                canvas.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                canvas.style.opacity = '0.99'; // Slightly transparent to ensure video shows
                console.log('🎨 Canvas set to transparent');
            }
            
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            const backgroundVideo = document.getElementById('camera-feed');
            let mindARVideo = null;
            
            // Find the video with active stream (MindAR's video)
            allVideos.forEach(v => {
                if (v.srcObject && v.videoWidth > 0) {
                    mindARVideo = v;
                    // Hide MindAR's internal video (we'll show our own background video instead)
                    v.style.display = 'none';
                    console.log('📹 Found MindAR video:', {
                        width: v.videoWidth,
                        height: v.videoHeight,
                        hasStream: !!v.srcObject
                    });
                }
            });
            
            console.log('📹 Total videos found:', allVideos.length);
            console.log('📹 MindAR video:', mindARVideo ? 'FOUND' : 'NOT FOUND');
            console.log('📹 Background video:', backgroundVideo ? 'EXISTS' : 'NOT FOUND');
            
            if (mindARVideo && backgroundVideo) {
                console.log('📹 Copying MindAR camera stream to background video...');
                backgroundVideo.srcObject = mindARVideo.srcObject;
                backgroundVideo.play().then(() => {
                    console.log('✅ Background camera feed now playing');
                }).catch(e => {
                    console.error('❌ Failed to play background video:', e);
                });
            } else {
                console.warn('⚠️ Could not find MindAR video or background video element');
                // List all videos for debugging
                console.log('📋 Available videos:', Array.from(allVideos).map((v, i) => ({
                    index: i,
                    width: v.videoWidth,
                    height: v.videoHeight,
                    hasStream: !!v.srcObject,
                    style: v.getAttribute('style'),
                    className: v.className
                })));
            }
        }, 500); // Small delay to ensure MindAR has initialized its video
        
        // Check if the mindar-image component is actually loaded
        const mindARComponent = scene.components['mindar-image'];
        if (mindARComponent) {
            console.log('✅ mindar-image component found:', {
                data: mindARComponent.data,
                hasData: !!mindARComponent.data
            });
        } else {
            console.warn('⚠️ mindar-image component not found');
        }
        
        // Check if image targets are loaded
        console.log('🎯 Checking for loaded image targets...');
        const targets = scene.querySelectorAll('a-entity[mindar-image-target]');
        console.log(`   Found ${targets.length} image targets`);
        targets.forEach((target, i) => {
            console.log(`   Target ${i}:`, {
                id: target.id,
                imageTargetIndex: target.getAttribute('target')
            });
        });
        
        // Track detection state
        let detectionHistory = [];
        let isTargetVisible = false;
        
        // Listen for MindAR's targetFound event
        scene.addEventListener('targetFound', (event) => {
            console.log('🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR', event);
            if (event && event.detail) {
                console.log('🔬 MindAR targetFound detail:', JSON.stringify(event.detail));
            } else {
                console.log('🔬 MindAR targetFound event has no detail');
            }
            
            // Add to history with timestamp
            detectionHistory.push({
                time: Date.now(),
                confidence: event.detail?.confidence || 0.9,
                anchor: event.detail?.anchor
            });
            
            // Record this found time for flickering detection
            lastTargetFoundTime = Date.now();
            
            // Keep only recent detections (last 200ms)
            detectionHistory = detectionHistory.filter(d => Date.now() - d.time < 200);
            
            // Apply confidence threshold
            const avgConfidence = detectionHistory.length > 0 
                ? detectionHistory.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.confidence, 0) / detectionHistory.length
                : 0.9;
            
            console.log(`📊 Detection confidence: ${(avgConfidence * 100).toFixed(1)}% (threshold: ${(window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
            
            // ===== DISABLED QUALITY SWITCHING (was causing instability) =====
            // Changing imageTargetSrc during tracking causes MindAR to reinitialize and lose lock.
            // The constant marker switching led to the find/lose/find/lose cycling.
            // Solution: Keep single stable marker, don't switch mid-tracking
            console.log('✅ Keeping single stable marker - quality switching DISABLED');
            
            // If below threshold, suppress the detection
            if (avgConfidence < window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold) {
                console.log('🚫 Detection rejected - below confidence threshold');
                return;
            }
            
            // Increment warmup counter
            window.detectionFilters.frameCount++;
            if (window.detectionFilters.frameCount < window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames) {
                console.log(`⏳ Warmup: frame ${window.detectionFilters.frameCount}/${window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames}`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Cancel any pending lost timeout since we found it again
            if (targetLostTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostTimeout);
                targetLostTimeout = null;
                console.log('🔄 Cancelled pending targetLost - re-detected!');
            }
            
            // Reset miss count since we found it
            window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
            
            // Apply exponential smoothing to anchor position for ultra-smooth tracking
            if (event.detail?.anchor) {
                const anchor = event.detail.anchor;
                
                // Store position in history
                window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.push({
                    x: anchor.x || 0,
                    y: anchor.y || 0,
                    z: anchor.z || 0,
                    scale: anchor.scale || 1
                });
                
                // Keep only last N positions
                if (window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length > window.detectionFilters.maxHistorySize) {
                    window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.shift();
                }
                
                // Calculate smoothed position (weighted average - more weight to recent frames)
                if (window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length > 0) {
                    let smoothX = 0, smoothY = 0, smoothZ = 0, smoothScale = 0;
                    let totalWeight = 0;
                    
                    window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.forEach((pos, i) => {
                        // More recent positions get higher weight
                        const weight = (i + 1) / window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length;
                        smoothX += pos.x * weight;
                        smoothY += pos.y * weight;
                        smoothZ += pos.z * weight;
                        smoothScale += pos.scale * weight;
                        totalWeight += weight;
                    });
                    
                    // Apply smoothed values back to anchor
                    anchor.x = smoothX / totalWeight;
                    anchor.y = smoothY / totalWeight;
                    anchor.z = smoothZ / totalWeight;
                    anchor.scale = smoothScale / totalWeight;
                }
            }
            
            // Detection passed all filters!
            if (!isTargetVisible) {
                isTargetVisible = true;
                console.log('✅ Target found and passed all filters! Dispatching custom event...');
                
                // Dispatch our own event that handlers can listen to
                const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersPassed', {
                    detail: {
                        anchor: event.detail?.anchor,
                        confidence: avgConfidence
                    }
                });
                console.log('🟢 Dispatching trackingFiltersPassed event:', customEvent);
                scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
            }
        });
        
        // Listen for MindAR's targetLost event
        let targetLostTimeout = null;
        let lastTargetFoundTime = 0;
        
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', (event) => {
            console.log('❌ TargetLost event received from MindAR');
            
            // Check if this lost came too quickly after a found
            // If so, ignore it (it's just noise/flickering)
            const timeSinceLast = Date.now() - lastTargetFoundTime;
            if (timeSinceLast < 200) {
                console.log(`⚡ Ignoring quick targetLost (${timeSinceLast}ms after found) - likely flickering`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Only process if we have a targetLost timeout pending
            // This debounces rapid lost/found events
            if (!targetLostTimeout) {
                window.detectionFilters.missCount++;
                console.log(`⏳ Miss count: ${window.detectionFilters.missCount}/${window.detectionFilters.missFrames}`);
                
                // Start timeout - if no targetFound within 1000ms, then it's really lost
                targetLostTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (window.detectionFilters.missCount >= window.detectionFilters.missFrames) {
                        console.log('❌ Target truly lost after miss tolerance');
                        isTargetVisible = false;
                        window.detectionFilters.frameCount = 0;
                        window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
                        
                        // Dispatch our own event
                        const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersLost');
                        scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
                    }
                    targetLostTimeout = null;
                }, 1000); // Wait 1000ms (doubled from 500ms) to see if targetFound comes back
            }
        });
        
        
        
        // Hide loader (handled by arReady now, but keep as backup)
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Force canvas to take full size and be visible
        setTimeout(() => {
            const canvas = document.querySelector('a-scene canvas');
            if (canvas) {
                const container = document.getElementById('ar-camera-container');
                const width = container ? container.clientWidth : window.innerWidth;
                const height = container ? container.clientHeight : window.innerHeight * 0.8;
                
                console.log(`🎨 Setting canvas size to ${width}x${height}`);
                canvas.width = width;
                canvas.height = height;
                canvas.style.width = width + 'px';
                canvas.style.height = height + 'px';
                // Make sure canvas is visible and on top - FORCE IT!
                canvas.style.opacity = '1';
                canvas.style.visibility = 'visible';
                canvas.style.zIndex = '10';
                canvas.style.position = 'absolute';
                canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                console.log('🎨 Canvas z-index forced to:', canvas.style.zIndex);
            }
            
            // Make video visible behind canvas
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log(`📹 Found ${allVideos.length} video elements, making them visible`);
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                if (v.videoWidth > 0 && v.videoHeight > 0) {
                    console.log(`📹 Video ${i}: ${v.videoWidth}x${v.videoHeight}, making visible`);
                    v.style.position = 'absolute';
                    v.style.top = '0';
                    v.style.left = '0';
                    v.style.width = '100%';
                    v.style.height = '100%';
                    v.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                    v.style.zIndex = '-1';
                    v.style.display = 'block';
                    v.style.visibility = 'visible';
                    // Apply B&W filter to all video elements (camera feed)
                    v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
                }
            });
        }, 100);
        
        // Safari-specific WebGL fix: Force context preservation
        setTimeout(() => {
            const sceneEl = document.querySelector('a-scene');
            if (sceneEl && sceneEl.renderer) {
                const gl = sceneEl.renderer.getContext();
                if (gl) {
                    console.log('🎮 WebGL context info:', {
                        vendor: gl.getParameter(gl.VENDOR),
                        renderer: gl.getParameter(gl.RENDERER),
                        version: gl.getParameter(gl.VERSION)
                    });
                    
                    // Force context to stay active (Safari fix)
                    try {
                        const loseContextExt = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context');
                        if (loseContextExt) {
                            console.log('✅ WebGL context preservation enabled');
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.warn('⚠️ Could not enable context preservation:', e);
                    }
                }
            }
        }, 200);
        
        // Debug: Check camera elements
        setTimeout(() => {
            const video = document.querySelector('a-scene video');
            const canvas = document.querySelector('a-scene canvas');
            console.log('🎥 Video element:', video ? `Found (${video.videoWidth}x${video.videoHeight})` : 'NOT FOUND');
            console.log('🖼️ Canvas element:', canvas ? `Found (${canvas.width}x${canvas.height})` : 'NOT FOUND');
            
            if (canvas) {
                console.log('🎨 Canvas style:', {
                    display: canvas.style.display || getComputedStyle(canvas).display,
                    visibility: canvas.style.visibility || getComputedStyle(canvas).visibility,
                    opacity: canvas.style.opacity || getComputedStyle(canvas).opacity,
                    zIndex: canvas.style.zIndex || getComputedStyle(canvas).zIndex,
                    position: canvas.style.position || getComputedStyle(canvas).position
                });
            }
            
            // Check all video elements
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log('🎥 Total video elements:', allVideos.length);
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                console.log(`Video ${i}:`, {
                    width: v.videoWidth,
                    height: v.videoHeight,
                    playing: !v.paused,
                    readyState: v.readyState,
                    srcObject: !!v.srcObject
                });
            });
        }, 1000);
    });
    
    scene.addEventListener('arError', (event) => {
        console.error('❌ MindAR error event:', event);
        console.error('   Error details:', event.detail || event.error);
        alert('AR Error: ' + (event.error || event.detail || 'Unknown error. Check camera permissions.'));
    });
    
    // Also listen for image target load errors
    scene.addEventListener('imageTargetMissing', (event) => {
        console.error('❌ Image target missing:', event);
    });
    
    // Monitor for network errors on .mind file
    console.log('🔍 Monitoring for .mind file loading...');
    const originalFetch = window.fetch;
    window.fetch = function(...args) {
        const url = args[0];
        if (url && url.includes('.mind')) {
            console.log(`📥 Fetching .mind file: ${url}`);
            return originalFetch.apply(this, args).then(response => {
                console.log(`   Response status: ${response.status}`);
                if (!response.ok) {
                    console.error(`❌ Failed to load .mind file: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
                    console.error(`   URL: ${url}`);
                    console.error(`   The file may not exist on the server or there may be permission issues`);
                } else {
                    console.log(`✅ .mind file loaded successfully`);
                }
                return response;
            }).catch(err => {
                console.error(`❌ Network error loading .mind file:`, err);
                console.error(`   URL: ${url}`);
                throw err;
            });
        }
        return originalFetch.apply(this, args);
    };
    
    // Setup swipe bar controls
    setupSwipeBarControls();
    
    // Setup gallery overlay
    setupGalleryOverlay();
    
    // Force gallery overlay styles via JavaScript
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        #gallery-overlay { background: #af1d1f !important; }
        .overlay-header { background: #af1d1f !important; padding: 14px 20px !important; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important; }
        #gallery-overlay-grid { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 2rem !important; padding: 1.5rem !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card { display: block !important; background: transparent !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card:active { opacity: 0.7 !important; transform: scale(0.98) !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card img { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block !important; border: none !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card h3 { padding: 10px 0 0 0 !important; font-size: 0.95rem !important; font-weight: 400 !important; color: #000 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
        .overlay-title { font-size: 1rem !important; font-weight: 500 !important; color: #000 !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; }
        .close-overlay-btn { background: transparent !important; color: #000 !important; font-size: 1.8rem !important; width: 40px !important; height: 40px !important; }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
    
    console.log('✅ AR.js scene initialized');
}

// Request camera permission
async function requestCameraPermission() {
    console.log('📸 Requesting camera permission...');
    
    // Try different camera configurations
    // NOTE: Ultrawide (0.5x) causes MindAR anchor offset issues
    // Prioritize 1x standard lens for accurate AR tracking
    const cameraConfigs = [
        // Config 1: Request standard wide camera explicitly (iOS: videoKind: 'main' means not telephoto)
        {
            video: { 
                facingMode: { exact: 'environment' },
                width: { ideal: 1920 },
                height: { ideal: 1080 }
            }
        },
        // Config 2: Standard back camera with 16:9 aspect ratio (prevents zoom)
        {
            video: { 
                facingMode: 'environment',
                width: { ideal: 1280 },
                height: { ideal: 720 },
                aspectRatio: { ideal: 16/9 }
            }
        },
        // Config 3: Request without zoom constraints
        {
            video: { 
                facingMode: 'environment',
                aspectRatio: { ideal: 4/3 }  // Wider aspect can help with no-zoom
            }
        },
        // Config 4: Default camera
        {
            video: true
        }
    ];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < cameraConfigs.length; i++) {
        try {
            console.log(`📸 Trying camera config ${i + 1}/${cameraConfigs.length}...`);
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(cameraConfigs[i]);
            console.log('✅ Camera permission granted with config', i + 1);
            console.log('📹 Stream:', stream);
            
            const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
            const settings = track.getSettings();
            const capabilities = track.getCapabilities ? track.getCapabilities() : {};
            
            console.log('📹 Track settings:', settings);
            console.log('📹 Camera capabilities:', capabilities);
            console.log('📹 Camera facing:', settings.facingMode || 'unknown');
            console.log('📹 Resolution:', `${settings.width}x${settings.height}`);
            
            // Log zoom/focusDistance info if available
            if (settings.zoom !== undefined) {
                console.log('🔍 Camera zoom level:', settings.zoom);
            }
            if (settings.focusDistance !== undefined) {
                console.log('📏 Camera focus distance:', settings.focusDistance);
            }
            if (capabilities.zoom) {
                console.log('🔍 Camera zoom capabilities:', capabilities.zoom);
            }
            
            // Store default zoom (1x standard lens)
            // Ultrawide causes MindAR positioning errors
            window.cameraZoomLevel = 1.0;
            console.log(`✅ Using 1.0x standard lens (MindAR compatible)`);
            
            // Apply distortion compensation with standard lens (minimal)
            applyLensDistortionCompensation(1.0);
            
            return stream;
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`❌ Config ${i + 1} failed:`, error.message);
            if (i === cameraConfigs.length - 1) {
                console.error('❌ All camera configs failed');
                throw error;
            }
        }
    }
}

// Apply lens distortion compensation for ultrawide camera
function applyLensDistortionCompensation(zoomLevel) {
    console.log(`🔧 Applying lens distortion compensation for zoom level: ${zoomLevel}`);
    
    // For ultrawide (0.5x), we need to compensate for barrel distortion
    const isUltrawide = zoomLevel <= 0.6;
    
    if (isUltrawide) {
        console.log('📐 Detected ultrawide lens - applying barrel distortion compensation');
        
        // Apply CSS-based barrel distortion correction to video feed
        const videoElements = document.querySelectorAll('#camera-feed, video');
        videoElements.forEach(video => {
            // Slight pincushion effect to counter barrel distortion
            // This is a subtle correction - too much looks unnatural
            video.style.transform = 'perspective(1000px) translateZ(-10px)';
            video.style.transformOrigin = 'center center';
        });
        
        // Adjust Three.js camera FOV for ultrawide perspective
        setTimeout(() => {
            const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
            if (scene && scene.camera) {
                const camera = scene.camera;
                
                // Ultrawide lenses have ~120° FOV, but we want MindAR to match it
                // Standard camera FOV is ~60-70°, ultrawide is ~90-120°
                // We'll increase FOV significantly to compensate
                const originalFov = camera.fov || 70;
                const ultrawideCompensationFov = Math.min(originalFov * 2.0, 120); // Up to 120° max
                
                camera.fov = ultrawideCompensationFov;
                camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
                
                console.log(`📷 Adjusted camera FOV: ${originalFov}° → ${ultrawideCompensationFov}° for ultrawide`);
                
                // Store for reference
                window.cameraFovCompensation = ultrawideCompensationFov;
            }
        }, 500);
        
    } else {
        console.log('📐 Standard lens detected - no distortion compensation needed');
        window.cameraFovCompensation = null;
    }
}

// ==================== CUSTOM INVERT SHADER ====================
const InvertShaderMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
        tDiffuse: { value: null },
        tNormal: { value: null },
        time: { value: 0 }
    },
    vertexShader: `
        varying vec2 vUv;
        void main() {
            vUv = uv;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
        uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;
        varying vec2 vUv;
        
        void main() {
            vec4 texColor = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
            
            // Invert RGB but keep alpha
            vec3 inverted = vec3(1.0 - texColor.r, 1.0 - texColor.g, 1.0 - texColor.b);
            
            gl_FragColor = vec4(inverted, texColor.a);
        }
    `,
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: true,
    depthTest: true
});

// Function to apply invert effect to a material
function createInvertMaterial(originalMaterial) {
    const material = originalMaterial.clone();
    
    // Use custom blend mode that inverts
    material.blending = THREE.MultiplyBlending; // Use as base
    material.blendSrc = THREE.OneMinusDstColorFactor;
    material.blendDst = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    material.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
    
    return material;
}

// Helper function to check if a matrix is identity (no transformation)
function isIdentityMatrix(matrix) {
    if (!matrix || !matrix.elements) return false;
    const e = matrix.elements;
    // Check if it's approximately identity matrix
    return Math.abs(e[0] - 1) < 0.01 && Math.abs(e[5] - 1) < 0.01 && Math.abs(e[10] - 1) < 0.01 &&
           Math.abs(e[12]) < 0.01 && Math.abs(e[13]) < 0.01 && Math.abs(e[14]) < 0.01;
}

// Add MindAR image targets
function addMindARTargets(scene) {
    console.log('📌 Adding MindAR image target...');
    
    // Add lights to scene
    const ambientLight = document.createElement('a-light');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('type', 'ambient');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('color', '#FFFFFF');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('intensity', '1');
    scene.appendChild(ambientLight);
    
    const directionalLight = document.createElement('a-light');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('type', 'directional');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('color', '#FFFFFF');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('intensity', '0.5');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('position', '1 1 1');
    scene.appendChild(directionalLight);
    
    // Create MindAR target entity
    const target = document.createElement('a-entity');
    target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
    target.setAttribute('id', 'ar-target-0');
    target.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    
    // Determine layer positions based on zoom level
    // Ultrawide (0.5x) needs much closer positions because perspective is wider
    const isUltrawide = window.cameraZoomLevel <= 0.6;
    let layer1Pos, layer2Pos, layer3Pos, layer4Pos;
    let layer1Scale, layer2Scale, layer3Scale, layer4Scale;
    
    if (isUltrawide) {
        console.log('🎯 Ultrawide lens detected - using scaled-down layer positions');
        // Ultrawide positions (much closer to poster)
        layer1Pos = '0 0 0.001';   // On poster surface
        layer2Pos = '0 0 0.02';    // 2cm away
        layer3Pos = '0 0 0.20';    // 20cm away
        layer4Pos = '0 0 0.30';    // 30cm away (middle of 25-35cm range)
        layer1Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer2Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer3Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer4Scale = '1.05 1.05 1.05';
    } else {
        console.log('📷 Standard lens detected - using normal layer positions');
        // Standard positions
        layer1Pos = '0 0 0.001';   // On poster surface
        layer2Pos = '0 0 0.02';    // 2cm away
        layer3Pos = '0 0 0.20';    // 20cm away
        layer4Pos = '0 0 0.30';    // 30cm away (middle of 25-35cm range)
        layer1Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer2Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer3Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer4Scale = '1.05 1.05 1.05';
    }
    
    // Layer 0: Black background - completely opaque, prevents seeing through
    const layer0 = document.createElement('a-plane');
    layer0.setAttribute('id', 'ar-layer-0');
    layer0.setAttribute('position', '0 0 -0.001');  // Just behind layer 1
    layer0.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
    layer0.setAttribute('width', '1.1');
    layer0.setAttribute('height', '1.54');
    layer0.setAttribute('scale', '1.0 1.0 1.0');
    layer0.setAttribute('material', 'color: #000000; shader: flat; transparent: false; side: double');
    layer0.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    target.object3D.add(layer0.object3D);
    
    // Get matched poster data to determine which layers to create
    // This will be populated later when targetFound fires
    // Don't create default layers - wait for actual poster data
    const createdLayers = [];
    
    // Default layer configurations (disabled - will create from poster data only)
    // const defaultLayers = [
    //     { z: 0.000, src: 'img/Drone_01.png', width: 1.1, height: 1.54, scale: layer1Scale },
    //     { z: 0.010, src: 'img/Drone_02.png', width: 1.1, height: 1.54, scale: layer2Scale },
    //     { z: 0.040, src: 'img/Drone_03.png', width: 1.1, height: 1.54, scale: layer3Scale },

    //       anim: { x: isUltrawide ? 0.003 : 0.01, y: isUltrawide ? 0.0015 : 0.005, z: isUltrawide ? 0.002 : 0.01, duration: 6000 } }
    // ];
    
    // Create layers 1-4 (will be updated with poster-specific data in targetFound)
    // DISABLED - wait for poster detection instead
    // for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
    //     const layerConfig = defaultLayers[i - 1];
    //     const layer = document.createElement('a-plane');
    //     layer.setAttribute('id', `ar-layer-${i}`);
    //     
    //     // Set initial position (Safari offset will be applied later if needed)
    //     let zPos = layerConfig.z;

    //

    //     layer.setAttribute('scale', layerConfig.scale);
    //     layer.setAttribute('material', `src: ${layerConfig.src}; shader: flat; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double`);
    //     layer.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    //     
    //     // Add animation if configured

    //         const anim = layerConfig.anim;
    //         layer.setAttribute('animation__x', `property: position.x; from: ${-anim.x}; to: ${anim.x}; dur: ${anim.duration}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
    //         layer.setAttribute('animation__y', `property: position.y; from: ${-anim.y}; to: ${anim.y}; dur: ${anim.duration + 1000}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
    //         layer.setAttribute('animation__z', `property: position.z; from: ${zPos - anim.z}; to: ${zPos + anim.z}; dur: ${anim.duration + 2000}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);

    console.log(`⏳ Waiting for poster detection - layers will be created dynamically`);
    
    // PRE-CREATE all AR layer elements (empty shells) so they're ready when target is found
    // This ensures A-Frame has time to integrate them into the scene before materials load
    for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {

            target.appendChild(layer);

        }
    }
    
    // CRITICAL: Register event listeners BEFORE adding target to scene
    // This ensures we don't miss the first targetFound event

    target.addEventListener('stableTargetFound', () => {
