```javascript
        targetFoundEventFired = true;
        
        // CRITICAL: Cancel any pending reset timeout
        if (targetLostResetTimeout) {
            clearTimeout(targetLostResetTimeout);
            targetLostResetTimeout = null;
            console.log('🔄 Cancelled pending reset - poster found!');
        }
        
        console.log('🎯 MindAR successfully found the marker!');
        
        // Get the marker path from the global variable we set during initialization
        const sceneMarker = window.currentMarkerPath || null;
        console.log('🎯 Scene marker:', sceneMarker);
        
        // Switch to state 2 (detected poster)
        showSwipeState(2);
        
        // Find matching poster based on ar_marker field
        if (window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0) {
            console.log('📋 All posters:', window.allPosters.map(p => ({
                title: p.title, 
                ar_marker: p.ar_marker,
                id: p.id
            })));
            
            // Try to match based on ar_marker field
            let matchedPoster = null;
            
            if (sceneMarker) {
                // Match by comparing ar_marker paths
                matchedPoster = window.allPosters.find(p => {
                    const posterMarker = p.ar_marker;
                    console.log(`🔎 Comparing: scene="${sceneMarker}" vs poster="${posterMarker}" (${p.title})`);
                    return posterMarker && sceneMarker.includes(posterMarker);
                });
            }
            
            // Fallback to first poster if no match found
            if (!matchedPoster) {
                console.warn('⚠️ No marker match found, using first poster as fallback');
                matchedPoster = window.allPosters[0];
            } else {
                console.log('✅ Matched poster:', matchedPoster.title, 'via ar_marker:', matchedPoster.ar_marker);
            }
            
            currentTrackedPoster = matchedPoster;
            document.getElementById('detected-poster-title').textContent = matchedPoster.title;
            console.log('📝 Updated footer title to:', matchedPoster.title);
            
            // Update AR layers with poster-specific data
            if (matchedPoster.layers) {
                console.log('🎨 Updating AR layers with poster-specific configuration...');
                for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
                    const layerData = matchedPoster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
                    const layerElement = document.getElementById(`ar-layer-${i}`);
                    
                    if (layerElement) {
                        if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                            // Update layer with poster data
                            const layerSrc = `/uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                            const materialAttr = `src: ${layerSrc}; shader: flat; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double`;
                            
                            layerElement.setAttribute('material', materialAttr);
                            layerElement.setAttribute('position', `0 0 ${layerData.z}`);
                            
                            // Apply blend mode if exclusion filter
                            if (layerData.exclusion_filter) {
                                setTimeout(() => {
                                    try {
                                        const mesh = layerElement.getObject3D('mesh');
                                        if (mesh && mesh.material) {
                                            mesh.material.transparent = true;
                                            mesh.material.opacity = 1.0;
                                            mesh.material.blending = THREE.CustomBlending;
                                            mesh.material.blendSrc = THREE.SrcColorFactor;
                                            mesh.material.blendDst = THREE.DstColorFactor;
                                            mesh.material.blendEquation = THREE.SubtractEquation;
                                            mesh.material.needsUpdate = true;
                                            console.log(`🎭 Difference blend mode applied to layer ${i}`);
                                        }
                                    } catch (e) {
                                        console.error(`Failed to apply blend to layer ${i}:`, e);
                                    }
                                }, 50);
                            }
                            
                            // Remove old animations
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__x');
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__y');
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__z');
                            layerElement.removeAttribute('animation__scale');
                            
                            // Add animation if configured
                            if (layerData.anim_duration > 0) {
                                const animX = layerData.anim_x || 0;
                                const animY = layerData.anim_y || 0;
                                const animZ = layerData.anim_z || 0;
                                
                                if (animX !== 0) layerElement.setAttribute('animation__x', `property: position.x; from: ${-animX}; to: ${animX}; dur: ${layerData.anim_duration}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                                if (animY !== 0) layerElement.setAttribute('animation__y', `property: position.y; from: ${-animY}; to: ${animY}; dur: ${layerData.anim_duration + 1000}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                                if (animZ !== 0) layerElement.setAttribute('animation__z', `property: position.z; from: ${layerData.z - animZ}; to: ${layerData.z + animZ}; dur: ${layerData.anim_duration + 2000}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                            }
                            
                            layerElement.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
                            console.log(`✅ Layer ${i} updated: ${layerData.filename} at z=${layerData.z}${layerData.exclusion_filter ? ' (exclusion)' : ''}`);
                        } else {
                            // No data for this layer - hide it
                            layerElement.setAttribute('visible', 'false');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Make ALL layers visible
        const layer1 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-1');
        const layer2 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-2');
        const layer3 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-3');
        const layer4 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-4');
        
        target.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer1) layer1.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer2) layer2.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer3) layer3.object3D.visible = true;
        if (layer4) layer4.object3D.visible = true;
        
        targetFoundTimestamp = Date.now();
        
        // Hide background video immediately on target found
        // Video hiding is INDEPENDENT of blend modes being ready
        // Blend modes are purely for visual effect, not for hiding/showing
        if (!videoHiddenForTarget) {
            console.log('✅ Target found - immediately hiding video');
            
            // Hide all video elements
            const backgroundVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            backgroundVideos.forEach(video => {
                video.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                video.style.opacity = '0';
                video.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; // Prevent interaction
            });
            
            // Hide A4 frame guide
            const a4Frame = document.getElementById('a4-frame');
            if (a4Frame) {
                a4Frame.classList.add('hidden');
                console.log('📦 A4 frame hidden');
            }
            
            // Make sure WebGL canvas is visible and on top
            const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
            if (canvas) {
                canvas.style.visibility = 'visible';
                canvas.style.opacity = '1';
                canvas.style.zIndex = '100'; // Ensure it's on top
                canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; // Enable interactions
                console.log('🎨 Canvas forced to foreground (z-index: 100)');
            }
            
            // Also hide any background overlays
            const bgElements = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="background"], [id*="background"]');
            bgElements.forEach(el => {
                if (el !== canvas) {
                    el.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                    el.style.opacity = '0';
                }
            });
            
            hideARLoader(); // Hide the loading spinner
            console.log('📹 Background video hidden');
            videoHiddenForTarget = true;
        }
        
        // DO NOT apply offset here - will be handled by continuous adjustment
        console.log('🎯 Target position (MindAR native):', {
            x: target.object3D.position.x,
            y: target.object3D.position.y,
            z: target.object3D.position.z
        });
    });
    
    target.addEventListener('stableTargetLost', () => {
        console.log('❌ Image target lost (stable)');
        
        // Switch back to state 1 (gallery button)
        showSwipeState(1);
        currentTrackedPoster = null;
        
        // If video was hidden, restore it after a delay
        // But ONLY if targetFound hasn't fired in the meantime
        if (videoHiddenForTarget) {
            if (targetLostResetTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostResetTimeout);
            }
            
            targetLostResetTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                // Double-check that video is still supposed to be hidden
                // (in case targetFound was triggered while we were waiting)
                if (videoHiddenForTarget) {
                    console.log('⏳ Restoring after 1000ms delay...');
                    
                    // Restore background video and canvas positioning
                    const backgroundVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
                    backgroundVideos.forEach(video => {
                        video.style.visibility = 'visible';
                        video.style.opacity = '1';
                        video.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                    });
                    
                    // Restore A4 frame guide
                    const a4Frame = document.getElementById('a4-frame');
                    if (a4Frame) {
                        a4Frame.classList.remove('hidden');
                        console.log('📦 A4 frame restored');
                    }
                    
                    // Reset canvas z-index to allow video underneath
                    const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
                    if (canvas) {
                        canvas.style.zIndex = '10'; // Back to default
                        console.log('🎨 Canvas z-index reset to default (10)');
                    }
                    
                    console.log('📹 Background video restored');
                    videoHiddenForTarget = false; // Reset flag for next detection
                    console.log('✅ Flag reset - ready for next detection');
                } else {
                    console.log('⏭️ Skipping restore - targetFound already triggered');
                }
                targetLostResetTimeout = null;
            }, 1000); // Increased to 1000ms to give MindAR time to re-stabilize
        }
    });
    
    scene.appendChild(target);
    
    console.log('✅ MindAR target with 4 image layers added');
    
    // LISTEN FOR FILTERED EVENTS on SCENE level and forward to target
    scene.addEventListener('trackingFiltersPassed', (event) => {
        console.log('✅ Forwarding trackingFiltersPassed -> stableTargetFound');
        const targetEl = scene.querySelector('[mindar-image-target]');
        if (targetEl) {
            const customEvent = new CustomEvent('stableTargetFound', { detail: event.detail });
            targetEl.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
        }
    });

    scene.addEventListener('trackingFiltersLost', (event) => {
        console.log('❌ Forwarding trackingFiltersLost -> stableTargetLost');
        const targetEl = scene.querySelector('[mindar-image-target]');
        if (targetEl) {
            const customEvent = new CustomEvent('stableTargetLost', { detail: event.detail });
            targetEl.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
        }
    });
    
    // Fix camera and renderer after scene is ready
    setTimeout(() => {
        const camera = scene.camera;
        const renderer = scene.renderer;
        
        if (camera) {
            // Fix camera near clipping (was 10, now 0.01)
            camera.near = 0.01;
            camera.far = 10000;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            console.log('✅ Camera near/far fixed:', camera.near, camera.far);
            
            // Safari-specific: Force aspect ratio recalculation
            const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
            if (isSafari) {
                console.log('🔧 Safari detected - applying browser-specific fixes');
                
                // Safari handles aspect ratio differently
                const width = window.innerWidth;
                const height = window.innerHeight;
                const aspectRatio = width / height;
                
                camera.aspect = aspectRatio;
                camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
                console.log('📐 Safari aspect ratio adjusted to:', aspectRatio);
                
                // Force pixel ratio consistency in Safari
                const pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                console.log('📱 Device pixel ratio:', pixelRatio);
            }
        }
        
        if (renderer) {
            const size = renderer.getSize(new THREE.Vector2());
            if (size.x === 0 || size.y === 0) {
                const canvas = renderer.domElement;
                renderer.setSize(canvas.width || 393, canvas.height || 556, false);
                console.log('✅ Renderer size fixed');
            }
        }
        
        // Force target and layers visibility
        const layer1 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-1');
        const layer2 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-2');
        const layer3 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-3');
        
        if (target.object3D) {
            target.object3D.visible = true;
            if (layer1) layer1.object3D.visible = true;
            if (layer2) layer2.object3D.visible = true;
            if (layer3) layer3.object3D.visible = true;
            console.log('✅ Forced all elements visible');
        }
    }, 500);
    
    // Continuous monitoring - track MindAR status
    let fixedMindARVideoSize = false;
    let targetWasDetected = false; // Track if target was ever detected
    let targetLostResetTimeout = null;
    
    // Listen for stableTargetFound event (redirected from scene by our listener above)
    target.addEventListener('stableTargetFound', () => {
        if (!targetWasDetected) {
            console.log('✨ Target detected and tracked (via stableTargetFound event)');
            targetWasDetected = true;
            
            // Cancel any pending reset
            if (targetLostResetTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostResetTimeout);
                targetLostResetTimeout = null;
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Listen for stableTargetLost event
    target.addEventListener('stableTargetLost', () => {
        if (targetWasDetected) {
            console.log('❌ Target lost (stable) - showing video again');
            
            // Show background video again so user can scan
            const backgroundVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            backgroundVideos.forEach(video => {
                video.style.visibility = 'visible';
                video.style.opacity = '1';
                video.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; // Re-enable interaction
            });
            
            // Show A4 frame guide again
            const a4Frame = document.getElementById('a4-frame');
            if (a4Frame) {
                a4Frame.classList.remove('hidden');
                console.log('📦 A4 frame shown');
            }
            
            videoHiddenForTarget = false;
            
            // Don't reset immediately, wait for potential re-detection
            targetLostResetTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                console.log('✅ Target reset - ready for next detection');
                targetWasDetected = false;
            }, 1000);
        }
    });
    
    setInterval(() => {
        // CRITICAL FIX: Force MindAR's video element to correct size
        // This is the root cause of Safari's positioning issues
        if (!fixedMindARVideoSize && target.object3D.visible) {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            let mindARVideo = null;
            let backgroundVideo = null;
            
            // Identify which video is MindAR's and which is background
            allVideos.forEach(v => {
                if (v.id === 'camera-feed') {
                    backgroundVideo = v;
                } else if (v.videoWidth === 0 && v.videoHeight === 0) {
                    // This is MindAR's video (currently 0x0)
                    mindARVideo = v;
                }
            });
            
            // If we found MindAR's video and it's still 0x0, fix it
            if (mindARVideo && mindARVideo.videoWidth === 0) {
                // Get the camera's actual resolution
                if (backgroundVideo && backgroundVideo.videoWidth > 0) {
                    const correctWidth = backgroundVideo.videoWidth;
                    const correctHeight = backgroundVideo.videoHeight;
                    
                    console.log(`🔧 Fixing MindAR video size: 0x0 → ${correctWidth}x${correctHeight}`);
                    // Force the canvas size in the scene
                    const canvas = document.querySelector('a-scene canvas');
                    if (canvas) {
                        canvas.width = correctWidth;
                        canvas.height = correctHeight;
                    }
                    
                    // This helps MindAR recalculate its projection matrix
                    const renderer = scene.renderer;
                    if (renderer) {
                        const pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                        renderer.setSize(correctWidth, correctHeight, false);
                        console.log('✅ Renderer resized to', correctWidth, 'x', correctHeight);
                    }
                    
                    fixedMindARVideoSize = true;
                }
            }
        } else if (!target.object3D.visible) {
            // Target is NOT visible - reset the fix flag so we try again next detection
            fixedMindARVideoSize = false;
        }
    }, 2000);
    
    // CONTINUOUS LAYER OFFSET ADJUSTMENT FOR SAFARI
    // Safari's MindAR pose is different from Chrome
    // Instead of offsetting the target, we adjust individual layer Y positions
    const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    const SAFARI_LAYER_Y_OFFSET = -0.35; // Shift layers down in Safari
    
    if (isSafari) {
        console.log('🔧 Safari detected - applying layer-level positioning fixes');
    }
    
    // Adjust layers every frame to compensate for Safari's different pose
    let lastSafariOffset = null;
    let offsetAdjustmentCount = 0;
    
    // Read offset from URL parameter if available (for testing: ?safariOffsetY=-0.3)
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    let safariYOffset = parseFloat(urlParams.get('safariOffsetY')) || -0.30;
    
    console.log(`🔧 Safari Y offset configured: ${safariYOffset} (use ?safariOffsetY=VALUE to adjust)`);
    
    function applySafariLayerAdjustment() {
        const layer1 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-1');
        const layer2 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-2');
        const layer3 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-3');
        const layer4 = document.getElementById('ar-layer-4');
        
        if (target.object3D.visible && layer1 && layer2 && layer3 && layer4) {
            if (isSafari) {
                // Apply Safari offset to each layer's Y position
                // Value is fine-tuned and can be adjusted via URL parameter
                
                // Only set if not already set (avoid redundant updates)
                if (lastSafariOffset !== safariYOffset) {
                    layer1.object3D.position.y = safariYOffset;
                    layer2.object3D.position.y = 0.02 + safariYOffset;
                    layer3.object3D.position.y = 0.20 + safariYOffset;
                    layer4.object3D.position.y = 0.30 + safariYOffset;
                    
                    // Update matrices for Three.js
                    layer1.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    layer2.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    layer3.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    layer4.object3D.updateMatrix();
                    
                    lastSafariOffset = safariYOffset;
                    offsetAdjustmentCount++;
                    
                    // Log first adjustment and every 60 frames
                    if (offsetAdjustmentCount === 1 || offsetAdjustmentCount % 60 === 0) {
                        console.log(`📍 Safari layer offset: y=${safariYOffset}`);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(applySafariLayerAdjustment);
    }
    applySafariLayerAdjustment();
    
    console.log('✅ MindAR target added');
    
    // NOW that targets are loaded, MindAR should auto-start (autoStart: true in HTML)
    console.log('🚀 MindAR configured to auto-start...');
}

// Setup AR Event Listeners (legacy, kept for compatibility)

// Setup Swipe Bar Controls
function setupSwipeBarControls() {
    const closeDetectionBtn = document.getElementById('close-detection-btn');
    const swipeBar = document.getElementById('ar-footer-swipe-bar');
    const footerHeader = document.querySelector('.footer-header');
    
    // Close detection button (state 2) - returns to state 1 and gallery
    if (closeDetectionBtn) {
        closeDetectionBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            console.log('❌ Closing detected poster, showing gallery...');
            
            // Switch back to state 1 (gallery)
            showSwipeState(1);
            currentTrackedPoster = null;
            
            // Collapse footer first
            swipeBar.classList.remove('detected-mode');
            swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
            
            // Clean up
            setTimeout(() => {
                const galleryContent = document.getElementById('gallery-content');
                delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
            }, 400);
        });
    }
    
    // Drag up to expand footer/gallery (single unified element)
    let touchStartY = 0;
    let touchCurrentY = 0;
    let touchStartTime = 0;
    let isDragging = false;
    let startHeight = 0;
    
    footerHeader.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
        // Ignore if touching the close button
        if (e.target.closest('.close-btn')) return;
        
        touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        touchCurrentY = touchStartY;
        touchStartTime = Date.now();
        isDragging = true;
        
        // Get current height
        const currentHeightVh = swipeBar.classList.contains('expanded') ? 94 : 6;
        startHeight = (currentHeightVh / 100) * window.innerHeight;
        
        // Remove transition for smooth dragging
        swipeBar.style.transition = 'none';
    });
    
    footerHeader.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        
        // Prevent page scroll/refresh when dragging footer
        e.preventDefault();
        
        touchCurrentY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        const deltaY = touchStartY - touchCurrentY; // Positive = drag up
        
        // Calculate new height (footer expands upward)
        const newHeight = Math.min(Math.max(startHeight + deltaY, window.innerHeight * 0.06), window.innerHeight * 0.94);
        swipeBar.style.height = `${newHeight}px`;
        
        // Show gallery content when dragging up
        const galleryContent = document.getElementById('gallery-content');
        if (deltaY > 20 && !galleryContent.dataset.loaded) {
            loadGalleryOverlay();
            galleryContent.dataset.loaded = 'true';
            galleryContent.style.opacity = '1'; // Direct visible, geen fade
        }
        
    }, { passive: false });
    
    footerHeader.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        isDragging = false;
        
        const touchDuration = Date.now() - touchStartTime;
        const dragDistance = touchStartY - touchCurrentY;
        const dragPercent = (dragDistance / window.innerHeight) * 100;
        
        // Restore transition
        swipeBar.style.transition = 'height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1)';
        swipeBar.style.height = ''; // Let CSS class handle it
        
        const galleryContent = document.getElementById('gallery-content');
        galleryContent.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
        
        const state1Active = document.getElementById('swipe-state-1').classList.contains('active');
        const state2Active = document.getElementById('swipe-state-2').classList.contains('active');
        
        const isExpanded = swipeBar.classList.contains('expanded');
        
        // If dragged more than 20% OR quick tap, toggle
        if (dragPercent > 20 || (touchDuration < 200 && Math.abs(dragDistance) < 10)) {
            if (!isExpanded && state1Active) {
                // Expand footer to show gallery
                swipeBar.classList.add('expanded');
                swipeBar.classList.remove('detected-mode');
                loadGalleryOverlay();
                galleryContent.dataset.loaded = 'true';
            } else if (!isExpanded && state2Active && currentTrackedPoster) {
                // Expand footer to show detected poster details
                swipeBar.classList.add('expanded');
                swipeBar.classList.add('detected-mode');
                showDetectedPosterDetails(currentTrackedPoster);
            } else if (isExpanded) {
                // Collapse footer
                swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
                swipeBar.classList.remove('detected-mode');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
                }, 400);
            }
        }
        // Dragged down while expanded - collapse
        else if (dragPercent < -10 && isExpanded) {
            swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
            setTimeout(() => {
                delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
            }, 400);
        }
        // Didn't drag far enough - snap to current state
        else if (isExpanded) {
            swipeBar.classList.add('expanded');
        } else {
            swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
            delete galleryContent.dataset.loaded;
        }
    }, { passive: true });
}

// Setup Gallery (no longer needed - integrated in footer)
function setupGalleryOverlay() {
    console.log('✅ Gallery ready');
}

// Load Gallery Overlay with all posters
function loadGalleryOverlay() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('gallery-overlay-grid');
    if (!grid || !window.allPosters) return;
    
    // Force CSS injection when gallery opens
    if (!document.getElementById('gallery-override-styles')) {
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'gallery-override-styles';
        style.textContent = `
            #gallery-overlay { background: #af1d1f !important; }
            .overlay-header { background: #af1d1f !important; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important; }
            .overlay-title { color: #000 !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; font-weight: 700 !important; letter-spacing: 0.15em !important; font-size: 0.85rem !important; }
            .close-overlay-btn { color: #000 !important; font-size: 2.5rem !important; }
            #gallery-overlay-grid { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 2rem !important; padding: 2rem 1.5rem !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card { display: block !important; background: #fff !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.25s ease !important; border-radius: 8px !important; overflow: hidden !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card:active { opacity: 0.85 !important; transform: scale(0.98) !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card img { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block !important; border: none !important; background: #000 !important; }
            .overlay-poster-card h3 { padding: 14px 12px !important; font-size: 0.85rem !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #000 !important; margin: 0 !important; letter-spacing: 0.05em !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; background: #fff !important; }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
        console.log('✅ Gallery CSS injected');
    }
    
    grid.innerHTML = window.allPosters.map(poster => {
        const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png';
        return `
        <div class="overlay-poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <h3>${poster.title}</h3>
        </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
    
    // Add click handlers
    grid.querySelectorAll('.overlay-poster-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const posterId = card.dataset.posterId;
            showPosterModal(posterId);
        });
    });
}

// Show detected poster details in expanded footer
function showDetectedPosterDetails(poster) {
    console.log('🖼️ showDetectedPosterDetails called with:', {
        title: poster?.title,
        ar_marker: poster?.ar_marker,
        id: poster?.id
    });
    
    const detailsContainer = document.getElementById('detected-poster-details');
    if (!detailsContainer || !poster) {
        console.error('❌ Missing container or poster data');
        return;
    }
    
    const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png';
    
    detailsContainer.innerHTML = `
        <img src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
        <h2>${poster.title}</h2>
        ${poster.description ? `<p><strong>Beschrijving:</strong> ${poster.description}</p>` : ''}
        ${poster.location ? `<p><strong>Locatie:</strong> ${poster.location}</p>` : ''}
        ${poster.photographer ? `<p><strong>Fotograaf:</strong> ${poster.photographer}</p>` : ''}
        ${poster.ar_marker ? `<p style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #666;"><strong>AR Marker:</strong> ${poster.ar_marker}</p>` : ''}
    `;
    
    console.log('✅ Detected poster details loaded:', poster.title);
}

// Show swipe bar state
function showSwipeState(state) {
    const state1 = document.getElementById('swipe-state-1');
    const state2 = document.getElementById('swipe-state-2');
    
    if (state === 1) {
        state1.classList.add('active');
        state2.classList.remove('active');
    } else if (state === 2) {
        state1.classList.remove('active');
        state2.classList.add('active');
    }
}

// Show desktop view (fallback)
async function showDesktopView() {
    if (isMobileDevice) {
        // Mobile device without HTTPS - show mobile UI with gallery only
        document.getElementById('desktop-view').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('mobile-ar-view').style.display = 'flex';
        
        // Hide AR scene, show footer for gallery access
        const arScene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
        if (arScene) arScene.style.display = 'none';
        
        const footer = document.getElementById('ar-footer-swipe-bar');
        if (footer) {
            footer.style.display = 'flex';
            showSwipeState(1); // Show gallery state
        }
        
        // Load posters for gallery
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters`);
            if (response.ok) {
                window.allPosters = await response.json();
                console.log('✅ Loaded', window.allPosters.length, 'posters for gallery');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error loading posters:', error);
            window.allPosters = [];
        }
        
        // Setup swipe controls for footer
        setupSwipeBarControls();
        
        // Setup gallery overlay
        setupGalleryOverlay();
        
    } else {
        // Desktop - show desktop view
        document.getElementById('desktop-view').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('mobile-ar-view').style.display = 'none';
    }
}

let currentPoster = null;

// ==================== MAIN INITIALIZATION ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    console.log('📄 DOM Content Loaded');
    
    try {
        // Detect device type
        isMobileDevice = detectMobileDevice();
        isARSupported = checkARSupport();
        
        console.log('📊 Detection Results:', {
            isMobileDevice,
            isARSupported,
            decision: (isMobileDevice && isARSupported) ? 'AR Mode' : 'Desktop Mode'
        });
        
        // Check if HTTPS or localhost
        const isHTTPS = window.location.protocol === 'https:';
        const isLocalhost = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1';
        
        if (isMobileDevice && isARSupported) {
            if (isHTTPS || isLocalhost) {
                console.log('🎯 Initializing AR Mode...');
                initializeARMode().catch(error => {
                    console.error('❌ AR Mode initialization error:', error);
                    console.log('⤴️ Falling back to desktop mode');
                    showDesktopView();
                    loadPosters();
                    setupModal();
                });
            } else {
                console.log('⚠️ Camera requires HTTPS - showing desktop mode');
                console.log('💡 Upload to HTTPS website to enable AR');
                showDesktopView();
                loadPosters();
                setupModal();
            }
        } else {
            console.log('🖥️ Initializing Desktop Mode...');
            showDesktopView();
            loadPosters();
            setupModal();
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ Critical error in DOMContentLoaded:', error);
        console.log('⤴️ Falling back to desktop mode');
        showDesktopView();
        loadPosters();
        setupModal();
    }
});

// ==================== DESKTOP GALLERY FUNCTIONS ====================
// (Keep all existing desktop functions from main.js)

// Laad posters van de server
async function loadPosters() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Kan posters niet laden');
        
        const posters = await response.json();
        displayPosters(posters);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading posters:', error);
        document.getElementById('poster-grid').innerHTML = `
            <div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 3rem;">
                <p style="color: #7f8c8d; font-size: 1.2rem;">
                    Geen posters gevonden. Start de server om posters te laden.
                </p>
            </div>
        `;
    }
}

// Display posters in grid
function displayPosters(posters) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('poster-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = posters.map(poster => {
        const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png';
        const uploadDate = poster.upload_date || poster.uploadDate || poster.created_at;
        return `
        <div class="poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img class="poster-image" src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <div class="poster-info">
                <h3 class="poster-title">${poster.title}</h3>
                <p class="poster-date">${uploadDate ? new Date(uploadDate).toLocaleDateString('nl-NL') : ''}</p>
                <p class="poster-downloads">Downloads: ${poster.downloads || 0}</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
    
    // Add click handlers
    grid.querySelectorAll('.poster-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const posterId = card.dataset.posterId;
            showPosterModal(posterId);
        });
    });
}

// Show poster modal
async function showPosterModal(posterId) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters/${posterId}`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Kan poster niet laden');
        
        const poster = await response.json();
        currentPoster = poster;
        
        // Update modal content
        const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : (poster.jpeg_url ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.jpeg_url}` : 'img/placeholder.png');
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-img').src = imageUrl;
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-img').onerror = function() { this.src = 'img/placeholder.png'; };
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-title').textContent = poster.title;
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-description').textContent = poster.description || '';
        
        // Location info
        let locationText = '';
        if (poster.location_description) {
            locationText = poster.location_description;
        }
        if (poster.latitude && poster.longitude) {
            locationText += locationText ? ` (${poster.latitude}, ${poster.longitude})` : `${poster.latitude}, ${poster.longitude}`;
        }
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-location').textContent = locationText ? `Locatie: ${locationText}` : '';
        
        // Article link
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-article').innerHTML = poster.artikel_link ? `<a href="${poster.artikel_link}" target="_blank">Lees het originele artikel</a>` : '';
        
        // Photographer credit
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-photographer').textContent = poster.photographer_credit ? `Foto: ${poster.photographer_credit}` : '';
        
        // Download count
        document.getElementById('modal-download-count').textContent = poster.downloads || 0;
        
        // Show modal
        document.getElementById('download-modal').style.display = 'block';
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading poster:', error);
    }
}

// Setup modal
function setupModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('download-modal');
    const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.close');
    
    closeBtn.onclick = () => {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
    };
    
    window.onclick = (event) => {
        if (event.target === modal) {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    };
    
    // Download buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('.download-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
            const format = e.target.dataset.format;
            const size = e.target.dataset.size;
            
            if (!currentPoster) return;
            
            const url = `${API_URL}/download/${currentPoster.id}?format=${format}&size=${size}`;
            window.location.href = url;
        });
    });
}

```

Perfect! Now I see the issue clearly. The logs show:

1. ✅ MindAR **IS detecting** the marker (`🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR`)
2. ✅ Warmup frames are being counted (`⏳ Warmup: frame 1/5`, `2/5`, `3/5`)
3. ❌ **BUT**: After frame 5 completes, nothing appears - NO `trackingFiltersPassed` event is dispatched!
4. ❌ The `stableTargetFound` listener is never triggered

**The Problem:** After the 5-frame warmup completes, the code should dispatch `trackingFiltersPassed`, but it's not happening. The `isTargetVisible` flag is probably preventing it from being dispatched again.

Let me fix this by resetting the `isTargetVisible` flag when we transition to a proper stable state: Now, the real issue: the `isTargetVisible` flag is set to `true` on the first pass through, but when it's not, the event never fires. Let me check and fix the event dispatch logic: Now let me verify the `trackingFiltersPassed` listener is properly set up and forwarding to `stableTargetFound`: Good! The forwarding is in place. Now let me verify the target listener for `stableTargetFound` is actually in place and logging: Perfect. The listener is there. The issue is likely timing - the target entity might not have registered its event listener before the `trackingFiltersPassed` event fires. Let me add extra logging and make the listener registration more robust: Now let me add more explicit logging to the target listener to see if it's receiving the event: Now test again. The new logs will show:
1. `🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR` - when the raw MindAR detects it
2. `⏳ Warmup: frame X/5` - during warmup
3. `✅ Warmup complete!` - when warmup finishes
4. `🟢 Dispatching trackingFiltersPassed event` - when sending the filtered event
5. `✅ Received trackingFiltersPassed on scene` - when the scene receives it
6. `🎯 Found target element, dispatching stableTargetFound` - when forwarding to target
7. `🎉 ===== stableTargetFound EVENT RECEIVED ON TARGET ELEMENT =====` - when target receives it

Please reload and scan the poster again with these new logs. This will show us exactly where the pipeline breaks.

Perfect! Now I see the **actual problem**:

```
🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR – CustomEvent {isTrusted: false, detail: null, initCustomEvent: function, …}
🔬 MindAR targetFound event has no detail
```

The event is firing on the **target element**, not the **scene**! The listener on `scene.addEventListener('targetFound'...)` is never being called. The event is being dispatched to the target element directly.

This is why the detection filters never trigger - the scene listener never receives the event.

**Solution:** Move the detection filter logic from the scene listener to the target element listener: Now I need to find where the target element's listeners are and move this logic there instead. The issue is that the scene listener is being added but never receives the event - it all goes to the target element. Let me simplify this by removing the scene listener and adding the detection logic directly to the target element: I need to complete the removal properly: Let me view more to find where the targetLost listener ends: I see - the incomplete code is before these other listeners. Let me find where the broken code is and fix it completely: I see the problem - my edit left orphaned code. Let me view a larger section and clean this up properly: Now I can see the broken structure. Let me fix it completely by removing the orphaned code block: Now let me add the proper detection filter listeners DIRECTLY on the target element where it's being created. Let me find where the target element listener for `stableTargetFound` is: There are two. Let me add a PROPER targetFound listener (not stableTargetFound) right after the target is created. Let me find where the target element is being created and added to the scene: Perfect! Right after `scene.appendChild(target)`, I'll add the detection filter logic. Let me insert it right there: Perfect! Now test again. The detection filter logic is now listening directly on the target element where MindAR actually sends the events. The flow should now be:

1. MindAR detects marker → `targetFound` fires on **target element** ✅
2. Our filter listens on target element ✅
3. After 5 warmup frames → dispatch `trackingFiltersPassed` on scene ✅
4. Scene listener forwards to target as `stableTargetFound` ✅
5. `stableTargetFound` listener on target shows the AR content ✅

Reload the page, scan the poster, and the logs should now show the complete pipeline. The AR should appear after holding steady for about 1 second.

Looking at the logs, I can see the problem clearly now:

**The detection pipeline is working** (warmup frames 1, 2, 3... are firing), but **it never completes the warmup cycle** (never reaches frame 5). The `targetLost` event keeps interrupting it before the warmup finishes.

The pattern is:
1. `targetFound` → Warmup: frame 1/5
2. `targetLost` → Miss count: 1/10
3. `targetFound` → Warmup: frame 2/5
4. `targetLost` → Miss count: 2/10
5. (repeats...)

**The root cause:** When `targetLost` fires, the `window.detectionFilters.frameCount` is NOT being reset, but the detection is getting interrupted by the miss counting logic.

Let me trace through and fix this: I see - the issue is that `window.detectionFilters.frameCount` keeps incrementing across targetFound/targetLost cycles, but it's getting interrupted constantly. The problem is that we need to keep the frame count across multiple targetFound events, but reset it when we get a genuine loss.

Actually, looking more carefully at the logs: the framecounts ARE incrementing (1, 2, 3...) but they're never getting to 5 before a targetLost breaks the cycle. The real issue is that the markers are flickering/unstable in MindAR itself.

However, we can fix this by making the warmup more lenient - instead of requiring 5 CONSECUTIVE frames without a lost event, we should count the frames as long as they're within a time window. Let me refactor this: Now test again. The warmup now works with a **time-based fallback**: 
- Either get 5 consecutive frames immediately, OR
- Get at least 3 frames within a 2-second window

This should work even with the flickering MindAR detection, because as long as the user holds the poster steady for 2 seconds with occasional detections (3+ frames), it will trigger.

I see the issue now. Every time `targetLost` fires, my code is resetting the warmup with `!warmupStartTime || Date.now() - lastTargetFoundTimeHandle > 2000`. Since the lost event comes within 2 seconds, it keeps resetting to frame 1.

The problem is that I'm checking the **time since last found** in the `targetFound` handler, but the `targetLost` events are coming so quickly that it resets the warmup every single cycle.

**The real fix:** Don't reset the warmup just because we got a targetLost. Keep accumulating frames as long as they keep coming within a reasonable time window. Only reset if we get a genuine, long loss (10+ seconds). Now test again. The key changes:
1. **Only initialize warmup once** - don't reset it when we get quick targetLost events
2. **Accumulate frames** - each targetFound increments the counter, regardless of targetLost events
3. **Accept 2 seconds of detection** - as long as ANY frames are detected within 2 seconds, warmup completes
4. **Lock in the result** - once warmup is complete (`warmupCompletedOnce = true`), subsequent targetFound events immediately show the content without re-filtering

This way, even with flickering detection, the AR content should appear after 2 seconds of holding the poster in view.

Ah, that explains it! You only uploaded layer_1 for testing. So the system is working correctly - it's displaying the one layer you uploaded. 

The black screen you're seeing is likely because:

1. **Layer 1 image might not be loading** - The texture path might be wrong, or the file isn't accessible
2. **The plane might be too small or positioned wrong** - Layer 1 might be rendering but not visible in the camera view
3. **The scale/size of the AR content might be off** - The plane dimensions might not match what you expect

Let me check the plane creation to see what size they are: Good - the planes are sized at `width: 1.1, height: 1.54` and start visible=false. They get populated when a poster is detected. 

Looking at the console output you mentioned earlier, the system is working - it's just the texture that's the issue. Let me create a simple test to see if the image file actually exists and is accessible. Let me add a fetch test: Now test on the iPhone again. The console will tell you:
- ✓ File exists if the layer_1 image is on the server
- ✗ File not found if the upload didn't work or the filename is wrong

**Pinpointing the Rendering Issue**

I've been meticulously examining the user's report of not seeing anything. The fact that neither the image nor the debug box is visible is a major clue. Despite the logs confirming textures are loading, something's clearly blocking the scene's rendering. My focus is now on the A-Frame setup and entity visibility.


**Troubleshooting Scene Visibility**

I'm now prioritizing the `targetLost` and `targetFound` events. The logs indicate the target is intermittently lost, which could explain the user's "nothing visible" report, even if the scene elements *should* be visible. My immediate next step is to examine the `mindar-image` system's behavior around target tracking and visibility updates. It's likely the cause.


**Revisiting Layering and Z-Index**

I've got a handle on the "neither" issue. My updated hypothesis is that the `<video>` element (camera feed) might be obscuring the `<canvas>` (AR scene) due to z-index. The logs confirm our efforts to force the canvas to the foreground, but the video remains visible. The fluctuating `targetLost`/`targetFound` events are concerning, as they may also be contributing.


**Inspecting CSS and Initialization**

I'm now fully immersed in `main.js`, especially the `initializeARMode` function, searching for CSS modifications and initialization steps related to the video and canvas elements. The inconsistent z-index values in the logs have me highly concerned. I'm also looking at the a-camera and considering other positioning issues. The goal is to ascertain what is obscuring the AR content.


**Scrutinizing the Initialization**

I'm now zeroing in on the `initializeARMode` function within `main.js`, and its interactions with the CSS. The inconsistency in the canvas z-index, as reported in the logs, worries me. I'm focusing on finding the point where the z-index is set and any potential conflicts with the video element's styling, hunting for the root cause of the rendering blockade.


I've updated the Z-Index logic in two places:
1. During initialization: Canvas `z-index` set to `999`, Video `z-index` set to `-2`.
2. During `targetFound`: Canvas `z-index` forced to `999`.

This should ensure the AR content (canvas) is rendered ON TOP of the camera feed (video).

Please test again.
- If you see the **Red Box** now, it was a Z-Index issue.
- If you still see **Neither**, then the canvas might be transparent but empty (camera/scene positioning issue).

What do you see?
